# Ajay Lalwani - Sea to Sky

Canonical website: https://ajaylalwani.com/

## Summary
Ajay Lalwani is a visually impaired endurance athlete, cyclist, and mountaineer documenting a Sea to Sky expedition from India's coastline toward Mount Everest.

## Primary pages
- https://ajaylalwani.com/ : Expedition overview and journey highlights
- https://ajaylalwani.com/about : Ajay Lalwani's story and achievements
- https://ajaylalwani.com/mission : The Sea to Sky expedition stages
- https://ajaylalwani.com/gallery : Expedition, certification, medal, media, and news archive
- https://ajaylalwani.com/contact : Support, sponsorship, media, and contact information
- https://ajaylalwani.com/privacy-policy : Privacy practices
- https://ajaylalwani.com/payment-policy : Payment and contribution guidance
- https://ajaylalwani.com/terms-and-conditions : Website and contribution terms

## Topics
Endurance cycling, mountaineering, visual accessibility, Everest expedition, athlete storytelling, and inclusive adventure.
